text:
sanjay: BlueHarbor just pushed for a hard go-live week of Jun 9-13. they want Private + Dedicated + KMS integration before launch. asking if we can commit.
raul_sales: they signed the paperwork if we hit that week. they brought up GDPR residency for EU customers too.
olivia_csm: BlueHarbor will need acceptance tests: SSO via SAML, exportable audit logs, and per-route latency SLAs. can share test harness.
marie: quick reality check — full KMS/HSM integration + enterprise SAML + EU VPC = a lot for 2.5 weeks. we need to define an MVP for go-live.
nina_eng: agree. engineering constraints: KMS HSM integration needs vendor cert + e2e rotation testing. SAML mostly works but we need to add attribute mapping and group sync. EU VPC provisioning depends on infra quotas.
sanjay: proposal: phase 1 (go-live): Private deploy in EU region using customer-managed keys via passthrough (no HSM), SAML with attribute mapping (no group sync), audit logs to customer S3. Phase 2 (30 days after): full HSM, automated key rotation, group sync, enhanced tracing.
raul_sales: customer will push back on "no HSM". they flagged compliance team. can we offer temporary attestation + SOC export until HSM is ready?
marie: we can do a written attestation and include SOC export in the contract as a temporary measure, but ops wants a clear rollback/fallback playbook.
nina_eng: ops note: if we do passthrough keys, we must restrict token caching and disable cross-region replication for that tenant. I'll document the security controls.
olivia_csm: acceptance criteria draft from customer side: 1) Successful SAML login + sample users. 2) All inference requests for their tenant served from EU nodes. 3) Audit log export demonstrates request-level tracing for 72h. 4) Response P95 < 450ms for baseline prompt set.
sanjay: add product "must-haves" for our side: A) Canary with 5% traffic routing and automatic fallback to hosted model variant. B) Rate-limit per-tenant with spikes protected. C) Post-launch quality smoke evals.
raul_sales: can we commit to canary start date Jun 6 and full traffic Jun 13 if metrics OK? that's their ask.
nina_eng: timeline constraints: EU VPC provisioning ETA Jun 4 (pending quotas). KMS passthrough path can be delivered by Jun 8 if no vendor delays. HSM path is earliest Jun 30.
marie: risk register: 1) KMS vendor cert delay (high) 2) Quota/infra failure (med) 3) Quality regression after model flavor change (med). need owners for each.
sanjay: owners: KMS vendor work -> nina_eng. EU infra quotas -> marie (eng-ops), quality -> olivia_csm + nina_eng.
olivia_csm: I'll prepare the customer test harness and seed prompts by Fri. can we get the SAML attribute map spec from BlueHarbor by tomorrow?
raul_sales: i'll ask legal/compliance if attestation + SOC export is acceptable as interim. will update EOD.
nina_eng: I'll put a short-runbook for passthrough keys in the repo and a checklist for disabling cache/replication per-tenant.
marie: can engineering commit to the canary metrics we care about? propose thresholds: error rate < 1%, p95 latency < 500ms, CPU < 70% on dedicated pool.
nina_eng: yes for those thresholds as targets. if any trigger breaches we pause canary and rollback to hosted variant.
sanjay: ok decision log for go-live: - Commit to canary Jun 6 (5% traffic) - Full go-live Jun 13 contingent on canary metrics + legal attestation - Phase 2 HSM + group sync targeted Jun 30 - Contract amendment: include SOC export + attestation as interim control.
olivia_csm: putting this in the customer-facing roadmap doc now. also scheduling a tech sync Thurs w/ BlueHarbor SREs.
raul_sales: thanks team. i'll push the commercial approval if we keep the HSM milestone out of the initial SLA.
deploy-bot: reminder: create release branch blueharbor/golive and tag v2025.6.13-canary when ready.
sanjay: next steps: nina to open KMS PR, marie to request EU infra quota, olivia to share test harness, raul to confirm legal acceptance. check-in tomorrow 10am.
marie: noted. I'll file the risks in JIRA and tag owners.
nina_eng: starting KMS ticket now. will post blockers in this thread.
olivia_csm: sharing prompts + harness link in #customer-docs after the sync. :thumbsup:
raul_sales: I'll update BlueHarbor with proposed compromise and timeline, try to soften HSM ask for go-live.
sanjay: thanks all. keep updates concise here. if anything critical, ping on phone.
